pairs.distinction: Education is about what kids get at school today; Kids' future is the broader worry that their whole lives will be harder than ours.
pairs.reason: Someone upset about their local school and someone dreading the world kids will inherit are naming different things, and a person can pick between them without thinking twice.

pairs.distinction: Kids' future compares one generation with the last; Opportunity compares people born in different places or families at the same time.
pairs.reason: Worrying that every kid will have it worse is not the same complaint as seeing some kids held back by where they started.

pairs.distinction: Climate change is one specific cause; Kids' future also covers costs, jobs, housing and the general sense that things are going backward.
pairs.reason: Many people who fear kids will have it worse are thinking about money and housing rather than the planet, so folding this into climate would lose them.
Losing my own nights to my phone is a personal pain while phones shaping a whole generation of kids is a societal one, so each belongs on its own page with a link between them.
